title: Tech Saturn Jan.1997: Kizuitara Gekkan-ka
native_title: ＴＥＣＨ ＳＡＴＵＲＮ ＪＡＮ．１９９７ 気づいたら月刊化
overview: Tech Saturn Jan. 1997 is the Sega Saturn CD-ROM that came packed in a sleeve inside the January 1997 issue of Tech Saturn, ASCII's Saturn magazine. Each issue's disc mixed trial versions of Saturn games with original content made by the magazine's own staff.
